description: List escrows on escro.ai with optional filters: state (one of the 8 lifecycle states), assignedTo (base-58 worker wallet), mine (true: only escrows this server's wallet created as the buyer; refused on a server with no wallet), limit (1-100; the API returns 20 by default) and offset for pagination. Call get_escrow for a single escrow. Read-only; needs no wallet except for mine.

assignedTo.description: Base-58 wallet; return only escrows assigned to this worker

limit.description: Page size, 1-100; the API returns 20 when omitted

mine.description: true: only escrows this server's wallet created (it is the buyer)

state.description: Return only escrows in this lifecycle state

name: list_escrows
title: List escrows
